description: This Java class defines an Android activity called ReorderOnLaunch. The activity sets a layout and assigns a click listener to a button, which starts another activity called ReorderTwo when clicked.

classes.name: ReorderOnLaunch
classes.description: An Android activity that launches another activity upon button click.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, finds the button, and attaches a click listener.
